description: Issuer data for an issued asset: flags, domain, transfer fee and total issued. When to use: Before accepting or sending an issued token: check that the issuer exists, is not frozen, whether holders need authorization, and the transfer fee charged on every transfer between non-issuer accounts. Prefer another tool: For XRP (not an issued asset; 400), for one account's own balances use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/lines`, and for prices use `/v1/xrpl/orderbook` or `/v1/xrpl/amm/{a}/{b}`. Example: xrpl_token {"asset":"USD.rHb9CJAWyB4rj91VRWn96DkukG4bwdtyTh"}

asset.description: Issued asset as CODE.issuer (3-character or 40-hex code, classic issuer address); not XRP

name: xrpl_token

age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

currency.description: Canonical currency code (3 characters or 40 hex)

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

domain.description: Issuer domain decoded to text, when set

obligations.description: Total issued of this currency; null when `obligations_status` is `unavailable`

title: Token issuer
